# Plan and Implement

## Change Summary

Implemented the pending carbonate follow-up amendments on top of the existing explicit-solver rollout. I documented the deliberate clamp-boundary trade-off in the carbonate solver so future maintainers know the clamped re-projection preserves DIC/cache idempotence while sacrificing strict alkalinity consistency at the storage bounds, added a precondition doc comment on `WaterState::total_tracked_ions_mg()` to make the bicarbonate-cache staleness window explicit, and corrected the schema 3->4 save migration so missing `animal.reserve_g` now stays on its serde default instead of being synthesized from legacy shrimp biomass. I also updated the legacy save regression to assert the zero-reserve migration behavior and removed the now-dead migration helper.

## Steps

0. [Completed] Inspect the pending amendments against the current carbonate rollout and identify the exact save-migration, solver-comment, and tracked-ion-cache changes still required.
1. [Completed] Patch the implementation by documenting the clamp-boundary DIC/alkalinity trade-off, documenting the `total_tracked_ions_mg()` resolve precondition, and converting the schema 3->4 reserve migration to a default-preserving no-op.
2. [Completed] Update regression coverage for legacy schema-3 saves and run formatting, targeted save/load validation, full `tank_core` tests, clippy, and surrounding preset/scenario regressions.

## Validation Evidence

- `cargo fmt --all` passed.
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test save_load` passed (19 tests), including `legacy_schema_v3_saves_leave_missing_reserve_at_default_zero`.
- `cargo test -p tank_core` passed across the full `tank_core` suite.
- `cargo clippy -p tank_core --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed.
- `cargo test -p tank_data --lib` passed (5 tests), including carbonate preset validation coverage.
- `cargo test -p tank_scenarios --lib` passed (2 tests), including shipped source-water pH materialization coverage.

## Outstanding Risks

- `solve_carbonate_equilibrium()` still uses the freshwater-focused approximation with fixed `Ka2`, so any extension beyond the intended pH 5.5-8.5 aquarium envelope should revisit the chemistry model.
- Legacy saves with custom out-of-range source-water catalog entries still deserialize, but runtime water-change actions against those profiles fail validation until the profile is corrected.
- The unrelated untracked `.ralph-burning/` directory remains in the worktree and was left untouched.
